poc_summary: POC run: dedicated 4x A10g nodes using Llama-2-13B quantized to 4-bit (q4_0) with prefix caching enabled. Load pattern simulated: 70% chat short prompts (avg tokens 20), 20% rerank hooks, 10% embeddings. Results: median latency 12ms token gen, p95 24ms, p99 48-65ms depending on cache hit; batching window tuned to 8-12ms improved throughput by 28% but raised p99 for cold paths. Action items: try q4_k and int8 kernels, enable KV prefix cache warmup for top-10k users, and run a 99th percentile-focused bench with 1M synthetic requests.
